使用者授權暨免責聲明

感謝您使用 PasswordVault（以下稱「本軟體」）。安裝並使用本軟體前，請詳閱以下內容。

一、憑證保護與救援限制
本軟體採用主密碼衍生金鑰保護您存放的密碼庫憑證，並不儲存主密碼本身，亦未設置任何形式的後門或救援機制。若使用者遺失主密碼，且未妥善保存 Passkey 或恢復金鑰，密碼庫裡所有已存憑證將永久無法復原，開發者及任何第三方均無法提供協助。使用者應自行妥善保管主密碼、Passkey 裝置及恢復金鑰。

二、使用者責任
本軟體提供之刪除已存憑證等操作皆無法復原，請於執行前確認其後果。使用者應自行負責憑證備份、主密碼管理及裝置安全，因使用不當、主密碼遺失、裝置遺失或其他因素導致之資料損失，開發者不負任何責任。

三、免責聲明
本軟體依「現狀」提供，不附帶任何明示或默示之保證，包括但不限於適售性、特定用途適用性之保證。開發者不保證本軟體完全無錯誤或不中斷運作。在法律允許之最大範圍內，開發者對於因使用或無法使用本軟體所生之任何直接、間接、附帶或衍生性損害，不負賠償責任。

四、同意條款
點選「我同意」即表示您已閱讀、理解並同意上述內容，並同意自行承擔使用本軟體之風險。若不同意，請勿繼續安裝。

END USER LICENSE AGREEMENT AND DISCLAIMER
Thank you for using PasswordVault (hereinafter referred to as the "Software"). Please read this Agreement carefully before installing and using the Software.

1. Credential Protection and Recovery Limitations
The Software protects the credentials stored in your password locker using a key derived from your master password. It does not store the master password itself, nor does it contain any backdoors or recovery mechanisms of any kind. If you lose your master password and have not properly secured your Passkey or recovery key, all credentials stored in the password locker will be permanently unrecoverable. Neither the developer nor any third party can provide assistance in recovering your data. You are solely responsible for safely maintaining your master password, Passkey devices, and recovery keys.

2. User Responsibilities
Actions provided by the Software, such as deleting a saved credential, are irreversible. Please verify the consequences before executing any such operation. You are solely responsible for credential backups, master password management, and device security. The developer shall bear no liability for any data loss resulting from improper use, a lost master password, lost devices, or any other factors.

THE SOFTWARE IS PROVIDED "AS IS", WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY AND FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. THE DEVELOPER DOES NOT WARRANT THAT THE SOFTWARE WILL BE ERROR-FREE OR UNINTERRUPTED.

TO THE MAXIMUM EXTENT PERMITTED BY APPLICABLE LAW, IN NO EVENT SHALL THE DEVELOPER BE LIABLE FOR ANY DIRECT, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES ARISING OUT OF THE USE OF OR INABILITY TO USE THE SOFTWARE.

4. Acceptance of Terms
